jobs.prompt: Use case: localized image edit. Image 1 is the user-accepted complete Sydney Opera House HD sprite and is the exact edit target. Make one restrained local refinement: increase the visibility of the EXISTING square tile grid and curved tile-course lines on the white/ivory roof shells. Follow the exact current grid paths, spacing, shell curvature and intersections. Use fine continuous crisp antialiased warm-gray joint lines, moderately darker and slightly more resolved so the existing pattern remains readable after independent 2X/4X game export. Keep the overall roof pale ivory and retain its smooth nuanced ceramic shading. Preserve the original patterns, design, colors, style, composition, all shell silhouettes, counts, overlap, viewpoint, native forms and light direction. Preserve the current stone podium, glazing, stairs, posts, material detail, shadows and every part outside the shell joint lines. No new architectural features, no new grid pattern, no heavy black outlines, no cartoon bands, no added grain/noise, no source pixel enlargement, blur or sharpening. Preserve genuine RGBA transparency and the current transparent openings and isolated sprite composition. Retain the current image dimensions and framing. This is a line-legibility refinement of the accepted artwork.

jobs.name: newurban-caeast01
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Rework one existing HD isometric Red Alert 2 / Yuri's Revenge building sprite. Image 1 is the original game design, palette, form and lighting authority; ignore its header and dark board background. Image 2 is the current HD sprite to correct. Preserve original patterns, design, colors, style, composition, exact source isometric viewpoint, silhouette, footprint and all recognizable forms. The user's correction is specifically that the current lighting and material detail is too simplified and cartoon-like. Reconstruct nuanced material shading, fine original structural detail, precise recess depth and coherent light-to-shadow transitions in the original pre-rendered C&C game-art aesthetic. Keep clear continuous crisp antialiased lines and clean high-resolution materials. Remove low-resolution grain, blocky patches and jagged edges. No enlargement, blur, sharpening, gritty noise, random speckles, new decoration, invented design, excessive wear or unrelated photographic scenery. No flat cartoon color bands, clay/plastic surface or exaggerated rounded toy bevels. Retain self-shadow and the original light direction. One complete isolated sprite, genuine RGBA transparency around and through all openings, no external cast shadow, ground plane, labels or watermark. The sprite should occupy about 92 percent of usable area and contain enough actual authored detail for independent 4X exports. Correct the exact original Easter Island moai. Preserve the tall slender source proportions, huge head, heavy straight brow and deep horizontal eye recess, long projecting nose, small mouth, pronounced chin, long column-like torso without invented arms, and original low oval ochre-edged base. Reconstruct dense matte carved stone with finely resolved material response, restrained coherent tonal variation, sharply defined original facial planes, controlled narrow bevels and subtle occlusion in the eye, nose, lip, chin and base recesses. Keep the source's muted rosy-gray/pink-tan lit planes and olive-brown shadows. The head and torso must read as weighty carved stone with crisp plane changes and nuanced lighting, avoiding the candidate's soft clay-like rounded surfaces and broad decorative pink patches. Do not add new cracks, veins, inscriptions, ornaments or damage to this undamaged state.
